annotations.text:
A · Quiet document
Serif headings, one column, thin rules. Reads like a well-set page and stays calm on a phone.

Best for: students who feel behind and want one clear instruction.
Tradeoff: more scrolling, less like software.

B · Focus band
A dark band carries the next step and its buttons; everything else sits in cards below.

Best for: looking like a real product, and for demos where the next action must be unmissable.
Tradeoff: the band eats vertical space and commits you to a heavy header.

C · Console
All weeks in a rail, numbers in tables, monospace figures. The model's reasoning is on screen rather than hidden.

Best for: advisers, teachers and your paper demo.
Tradeoff: dense and technical for a nervous class 12 student.
You can mix these: A for the student side, C for advisers and admin. Say which screens you want from which page and I will build only those.
